summary: Teaches creating a ping synthetic check, choosing probes and viewing its dashboard in Synthetic Monitoring.

needs.description: grafana-synthetic-monitoring-app installed; path has an initialize-plugin step, so it must be uninitialized (or the step tolerates already-initialized state)
Prometheus and Loki data sources auto-created by SM initialization (metrics/logs for view-check-dashboard)
needs.evidence: initialize-plugin: automatically creating the required Prometheus and Loki data sources

needs.description: Public probes available (North California, Singapore, Frankfurt) and internet reachability to grafana.com target

needs.evidence: Before you begin: permissions to install plugins

needs.description: A few minutes of check results so the Uptime panel populates
needs.evidence: view-check-dashboard: Refresh after a few minutes to allow data to populate

reviewNotes: If the stack's SM plugin is already initialized, initialize-plugin step may fail unless it has skip; a pre-existing job named grafana-ping-check could conflict.
